args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'.
- The saved report probably needs its label updated to Pellow Home Living so it matches the current name.

Thanks,
Sofia
